verdict.rationale: Jules has a documented public API (developers.google.com/jules/api) with API key management, session creation, message sending, plan approval, and automation mode fields, explicitly intended for building custom workflows and integrations; community evidence corroborates real third-party use (e.g., an MCP server built against the Jules API). Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec or llms.txt was found (probes 404), and no independent large-scale integration case studies beyond one hobbyist example.
